text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut... This day is finally here...
I-I-I'm shaking all over...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even my sense of time feels completely messed up.
Didn't that bus ride feel way too long?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's Kokura Racecourse after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kokura... In Kyushu...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it! You did say it was an expedition to Kyushu, didn't you?! Awawa~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She completely forgot... For her Make Debut, there just happened to be a 2,000m race in Kokura, so I decided to enter her there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Hishi Miracle tends to be sluggish,
sprint races with frantic starts aren't suited for her.
—That was the reasoning behind the decision.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
Here I go... Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I've done my visualization training, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: Aren't you heading out to the paddock?
Aren't you going out to the paddock?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll go.
I will, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my stomach hurts.
It's totally different from mental training after all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, a real, serious race
is just impossible for someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle slowly shrinks back.
She seems daunted by the looming wall of her real debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As usual, this might be a spot where she can't move forward without some encouragement. In that case—
choice_data_list: This place is perfect for you!
This place is perfect for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeh... Oh, stop it...
choice_data_list: I just came from training, after all.
I just came from training, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's... a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, did I do it...?
Though I might've slacked off once in a while...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, I did pretty well, for me.
Yeah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa~...
Do you really mean that? Sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still... you're right. If only to repay the kindness you've shown me and live up to your expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone around me is dead serious...
Their eyes are terrifying. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Hang in there, me.
It's all about how you look at it, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just being able to debut is a miracle!
This is a super preee-cious memory too, you know!
